plastfps.option.fps_boost.tooltip: Disables bubbles (soul sand / columns), splashes, drips, smoke and other ambient particles to improve FPS.
plastfps.option.full_bright.tooltip: Raises gamma so caves and dark areas stay visible. Turn off to restore your previous brightness.
plastfps.option.world_customizer.tooltip: Changes sky color. Enter color as RRGGBB (for example, 78A7FF).
plastfps.option.aspect_ratio.tooltip: Stretches the view horizontally. 1.00 is normal, higher is wider, lower is narrower.
plastfps.option.jump_circle.tooltip: Draws expanding rings on the ground when you jump.
plastfps.option.target_hud.tooltip: Particles around a player you recently hit or aimed at. Does not work on invisible targets.
plastfps.option.inventory_help.tooltip: Highlights in inventory and on the ground: Mending armor, golden and enchanted golden apples, swords.
plastfps.option.item_name.tooltip: Shows item name above ground drops, including colored custom names.
plastfps.option.armour_hud.tooltip: Shows equipped armor and remaining durability next to the hotbar.
plastfps.option.potion_hud.tooltip: Lists active potion effects with name and remaining time on the side.
plastfps.option.inventory_hud.tooltip: Mini inventory on screen. Open chat (T) and drag panels with the mouse.
plastfps.option.cooldown_hud.tooltip: Shows items currently on cooldown with seconds remaining.
plastfps.hud.drag_hint: Open chat (T) to drag HUD elements
plastfps.option.client_hud.tooltip: Shows plast client boostit at the top. On servers, adds bold green Mod creator next to plastfps in tab and chat without removing donate prefixes.
